skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 200% ATK to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 5000% ATK of Specialized Direct DMG (only affected by high-level DMG Free) to all targets, ignores 45% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Free], and pierces through [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding].Inflicts [Energy Suppression] on the 3 enemies with highest ATK, lasting 2 turns.——— [Energy Suppression]: when dealing DMG to HP/[Specialized HP], causes the target to activate 1x [Energy Conversion] (reduces DMG received and converts it into [Shield]).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Gain 20% [Rage] and [Shield Break]. ATK 5000% → 7000%. Ignores [Specialized Evasion] 45% → 60%. Inflicts [Energy Suppression] on 3 enemies → all enemies.——— [Shield Break]: during an attack, ignore the enemy's 30% DMG Free and Specialized DEF.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). After any ally acts, launches an [Ultimate Follow-up] on the whole enemy team for 80%, up to 2 times per round, and restores [Specialized Guard] equal to 50% of the DoT from [Detonation].

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, summons Hellish Blizzard to assist in battle, 100% ATK of UR TT. After UR TT acts or launching Ultimate Follow-Up, Hellish Blizzard will attack with the same style. Basic - Deals 100% ATK damage to a random target. Ultimate - Attacks all enemies with 3 consecutive strikes and deals DMG by 100% ATK and detonates [Field] (DOT by 100%) After any character acts, recover from [Stun/Specialized Stun].

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, summons Hellish Blizzard to assist (100% (120%) ATK of Terrible Tornado). After Terrible Tornado acts or launches an [Ultimate Follow-up], Hellish Blizzard attacks in the same style. Basic: deals 100% ATK DMG to a random target. Ultimate: attacks all enemies with 3 consecutive strikes for 100% ATK and detonates [Field] (DoT 100% (160%) ATK). After any character acts, recovers from [Stun]/[Specialized Stun].

effects.desc: PvP (advanced) tier of Resilience — shield ignores stronger damage, only penetrated by advanced breakers.
Shield ignores damage from certain attacks. Must be penetrated by Breakthrough or Charge/True DMG.
When an enemy carrying [Energy Suppression] damages the carrier, the damage is reduced by 20% and the reduction is converted into energy.
The shield absorbs damage up to a portion of the subject's Health; Charge DMG ignores it.
Reduces all non-critical damage (usually to 1). Cannot survive and avoid Agility.
The PvP tier's unique health bar stacks on top of regular health, must also be depleted, and can be restored independently.
Evasion PvP tier — reduces specialized attacks to 1 damage; pierced by the ignore dodge effect.
While attacking, ignore the enemy's 30% Damage Immunity and Unique Defense to allow the attack to penetrate their shield.
Attack buff increases unit damage, often accompanied by [Shield Break].
The battlefield effect deals damage over time (100%) and can be detonated for a burst of damage, and helps the character recover from Stun after an action.
When dealing damage to health, forces the target to activate Energy Conversion, reducing the damage they deal and choking their mana source.
